title: Robert Hastings exposes Bill Moore's intelligence connections

tellings.quote: and it was Robert Hastings, by the way, who in my opinion is probably more than anyone else responsible for the takedown of Bill Moore.

plain: Between 1987 and 1989, a UFO researcher named Robert Hastings is said to have done more than anyone else to bring down Bill Moore, a fellow UFO researcher whose ties to intelligence agencies became a scandal in the field. That is the opinion of the UFO historian Richard Dolan, who gives it on the show without saying where it comes from, though he credits articles in the MUFON journals, the publications of the Mutual UFO Network, a large civilian UFO group. If true, it means the exposure of a researcher who had been working with intelligence officers came from inside the UFO community itself.
